new_claims.statement: For a two-dimensional orthonormal product projection U with row leverages <=1/2, invertible symmetric Lambda, and arbitrary coordinate-separable perturbations, the quadratic output has an L3 density with norm <=(3B(U))^(2/3)|det Lambda|^(-1/3), B(U)<=e.

For a scalar projected square from one original product bank and a diffuse invertible rank-two quadratic on a disjoint product bank, whose two projected coordinates may be dependent and whose original coordinates may carry arbitrary separable perturbations, the density is bounded by 144^(1/3)B(U)^(2/3)[|a|rho^2|det Lambda|]^(-1/3), hence by (144e^2)^(1/3) times the same currency without B. Fixed two-bank density is C0.
